purpose: 微课堂小红书图文推广初稿：收藏夹自嘲切入，供审阅

images.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished Chinese Xiaohongshu carousel content poster, portrait aspect ratio EXACTLY 3:4, 1536 x 2048 pixels. Page 2 of a three-page campaign for 微课堂. Entire image is the poster, no device frame, no multi-poster montage. Match this shared art direction: warm ivory lightly textured paper, dark forest-green bold Chinese type, restrained vermilion and mustard accents, tactile handmade paper-clay miniature illustration, premium editorial composition, abundant breathing space, consistent large safe margins. This should be engaging mobile-readable content, not a dense product manual. All Chinese must be sharp and verbatim.
At top, two large heading lines:
"今天，只学"
"一个小问题"
Below in a shorter readable line:
"比如：前端和后端怎么配合？"
Middle to lower area uses three spacious stages arranged vertically, linked subtly by one warm green thread. Each stage has one compact expressive clay illustration and ONE big label, no other details:
1. a tiny open book with a simple connected diagram, label "看懂一点";
2. a pencil and one checked answer card, label "动手试试";
3. two speech bubbles and the same small round ivory clay learner now curious, label "没懂就问".
This visual represents reading explanations, practice, and asking follow-up questions. Do not depict importing bookmarks, parsing code automatically, or fake software UI. Footer in medium clearly readable text: "微课堂，把想学的拆成小步".
No other text, no tiny legal copy, no watermark, no platform logo, no website URL. Use an editorial layout with three readable visual beats rather than three boxed cards.

Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished Chinese Xiaohongshu carousel closing poster, portrait aspect ratio EXACTLY 3:4, 1536 x 2048 pixels. Page 3 of a three-page campaign for the open source learning app 微课堂. Entire image is the poster, no device frame, no multi-poster montage. Shared art direction: warm ivory subtly textured paper, very dark forest-green bold Chinese typography, restrained vermilion and mustard accents, tactile handmade paper-clay miniature illustration with realistic materials and gentle shadows, witty and warm adult editorial design. Large margins, short text, phone-readable hierarchy.
At top render these exact two large heading lines:
"给「以后再学」"
"一个今天"
Central illustration: the same small round ivory clay learner from the imagined series is connecting a few colorful knowledge pieces with forest-green thread on a tabletop. Include a simple small calendar beside the map as a metaphor for revisiting learning. Build a modest evolving connected map, not a completed mastery trophy. No screen, no fake UI, no quantitative performance promises.
Below illustration, strong product name:
"微课堂"
Then exactly these two spacious short lines:
"每次约10分钟，学一点、练一下"
"按掌握情况复习，慢慢连成认知地图"
Bottom in comfortably legible smaller type, all safely inset:
"开源学习工具 · mini-classroom"
"需配置AI模型服务，调用可能产生费用"
No additional words, no watermark, no platform logo, no URL or QR code. Keep the main point emotional and approachable, with the small cost note understated but readable.
